Right after, search-api fails to decode /products/batch responses (missing field 'status'), and web-bff starts returning 502s from 06:17:50 on. Before the deploy, catalog responses were OK and there were no errors.
The schema mismatch could also be read as a data or contract integrity problem, but the timing points to the release.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll catalog-svc back to v5.23.9, or turn off serializer v2. After that, keep the response contract backward compatible (keep the "status" field) until search-api can read "state".
